research_rejections.title: Scooby-Doo
research_rejections.reason: The Spooky Island demon investigation is presented as a PG family comedy/mystery rather than serious mature fantasy with sustained invented-world history, magic systems, or kingdoms. Sources consulted: https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/1112357-scoobydoo and https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0267913/plotsummary/.

research_rejections.title: Lifepod
research_rejections.reason: A spacecraft escape-pod survival and sabotage mystery, explicitly science fiction rather than magic- or mythology-based fantasy. Sources consulted: https://www.filmdienst.de/film/details/64374/lifepod and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lifepod_(1993_film).
